author: Elastic
attributes.description: Detects ChatGPT Enterprise Gmail connector searches that look like sensitive discovery: attachment hunts across multiple document types, or queries matching credential, financial, HR, or legal themes. Attackers abusing a linked Gmail connector after session compromise often search mail for high-value content before exfiltration or send-as abuse.
false_positives: HR, legal, finance, or IR users who legitimately search Gmail for attachments, payroll, or contract terms via ChatGPT.
attributes.name: OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise Suspicious Gmail Discovery
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise Suspicious Gmail Discovery

A Gmail connector search matched attachment or document-type hunting, or sensitive themes (credentials, financial, HR,
or legal). That can indicate collection staging through ChatGPT after connector or session abuse.

Escalate when searches are broad (`has:attachment` plus many `filename:` filters), credential keywords appear, or
nearby Gmail sends or Drive downloads follow. Close as a false positive for approved HR, legal, or finance research.

#### Possible investigation steps

- Review `Esql.email_search_query` and the boolean match flags on the alert.
- Correlate with Gmail send events, Google Drive downloads, or unusual authentication activity for the same user.
- Confirm whether Gmail connector use is approved for that user and whether the search matches their role.
- Check whether the same user recently linked the Gmail connector or created Codex access tokens.

### False positive analysis

- HR, legal, finance, or incident-response users refining attachment searches or payroll and contract lookups can match
  these patterns when using an approved Gmail connector.

### Response and remediation

- Revoke Gmail connector access if unauthorized, review retrieved mail and attachments, and treat exposed content per
  your data-incident process.
- Hunt for follow-on Gmail sends, Drive downloads, or conversation shares from the same user.
attributes.query:
from logs-openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log-* metadata _id, _version, _index
| where
    data_stream.dataset == "openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log" and
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log.app_name == "Gmail" and
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log.app_type == "SERVICE" and
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log.input is not null
| eval Esql.email_search_query = to_lower(field_extract(openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log.input, "query"))
| eval
    Esql.attachment_search = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*has:attachment.*""",
    Esql.document_extension = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*filename:(pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|csv|ppt|pptx|txt|rtf|odt|ods|zip|7z|rar).*""",
    Esql.multiple_filetypes = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*filename:[a-z0-9]+.*filename:[a-z0-9]+.*""",
    Esql.match_financial = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*(payslip|paystub|payroll|salary|compensation|bonus|bank.account|swift|routing.number|invoice|tax.return|w2|w-2|1099).*""",
    Esql.match_hr = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*(employment.contract|offer.letter|employment.agreement|employee.records|passport|national.insurance|social.security|ssn|date.of.birth|personal.data).*""",
    Esql.match_legal = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*(confidential|restricted|internal.only|legal|settlement|merger|acquisition).*""",
    Esql.match_credentials = Esql.email_search_query rlike """.*(password|passwd|credential|api.key|secret.key|private.key|access.token|client.secret|recovery.code|backup.code|ssh.key).*"""
| where
    (Esql.attachment_search == true and (Esql.document_extension == true or Esql.multiple_filetypes == true)) or
    Esql.match_credentials == true or
    Esql.match_financial == true or
    Esql.match_legal == true or
    Esql.match_hr == true
| keep
    _id, _version, _index, @timestamp, user.id, user.email,
    Esql.email_search_query,
    Esql.attachment_search,
    Esql.document_extension,
    Esql.multiple_filetypes,
    Esql.match_financial,
    Esql.match_hr,
    Esql.match_legal,
    Esql.match_credentials,
    openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log.input,
    data_stream.*
attributes.setup:
## Setup

This rule requires the OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise integration to collect `app_log` events for the Gmail app
(`app_type: SERVICE`) with flattened `openai_chatgpt_enterprise.app_log.input` fields, including `query`.

https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/integrations/openai_chatgpt_enterprise
